title: The Lock Call: Tuesday, November 24
blurb: Brett and Merv took opposite sides and nobody lost, the president grades his own card, and Edwin starts a list.

lines.text: [excited] Merv and I bet opposite sides of the same game, and somehow nobody lost!
[grinning] And the president graded his own card. Eight picks. Go!
From The Window at Hardwood Bricks, this is Tops and Bottoms, the Lock Call. I'm Leslie Phyllis.
And I'm Brett Busberger. Leslie, on Sunday the president posted a list of his own wins. He titled it, Wins of President Trump.
[laughs] Honey, around here somebody else keeps the board.
[grumbling] Smart. I got a list too. Wins of Edwin.
[dry] Short read, Edwin. Five of them. Right next to the five losses.
Today's picks. I've got the over, one seventy-three and a half, Queens at Wofford. And Grand Canyon, plus one and a half, against Saint Louis.
Coppin State at Villanova, the under, one forty-four and a half. And High Point, laying ten and a half against Duquesne.
Same game, Merv, and this time I'm with you. Coppin State, plus thirty-one and a half. And Sam Houston, plus four and a half at Washington State.
[out of breath] U L Monroe, plus one and a half at home. And the over, one fifty-three and a half. Three crates of lemons fell off a bakery truck. Don't ask.
The board. Yesterday, Akron and Wright State landed right on the number. Merv and I both pushed.
Nobody at the table was wrong, young man. I can live with that.
I split, one and one, and I'm still on top. Eight and two, up five point two eight units. Merv's seven, two and one. Brett's six, three and one.
[wheezing] And I'm five and five. Put that on the list.
That's the Lock Call. The picks column is up now at hardwood bricks dot com.
Twenty-one and up. If gambling's a problem, call one eight hundred GAMBLER.
Keep it mid. Keep it real.

news.item: On Sunday Nov 22 on Truth Social, President Trump posted a list headlined "Wins of President Trump." The show names only the post and its title, not its contents.

notes.board: Standings through Nov 23; yesterday = Nov 23 card (Akron +2 and Wright State -2 both pushed, final 64-66).
